Define explicit candidate identity switches and draw coherent assignments

Source: R/identity-scenarios.R
aqt_identity_switch_scenarios.Rd

Each candidate event swaps two CURRENT assigned tracker labels in ONE session/camera, from an explicitly recorded time onward. There is no automatic biological identity recognition and no probability estimation: probabilities must be justified by independent annotations or sensitivity assumptions. Swaps are sampled once per crossing event and applied to entire subsequent track segments, not independently to each video frame.

Usage

aqt_identity_switch_scenarios(
  tracks,
  candidate_events,
  draws = 200L,
  seed = 7L
)

Arguments

tracks

Canonical aqt_tracks with unique scoped track IDs per time.

candidate_events

Table with session_id, camera_id, track_a, track_b, at_s and probability_swap. All required.

draws

Number of assignment scenarios (>= 1).

seed

Integer RNG seed; preserves the global RNG state.

Value

aqt_identity_scenarios containing original trajectories, candidate switch events, and a draw-by-event logical decision matrix.
